newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae see 96 current profit in line pvs estimate.
newsitem.headline: Sonae see 96 current profit in line pvs estimate.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos's 1996 current results are in line with its previous estimate published in September, the Portuguese industrial group said in a statement.
Sonae said in September current profits in 1996 would stand at 17.5 billion escudos, 16 percent more than in 1995.

But the company said that some of the asset sales intended for 1996 would not necessarily be concluded by the end of the year and as a result the level of extraordinary earnings could be slightly below forecast.
Sonae Investimentos had forecast extraordinary earnings of 5.6 billion escudos.
